title: UpdateNdjsonRecord
description:
One NDJSON record emitted by `rwv update --json -j N` with `N > 1`.

Each record is a flat JSON object with `$schema` embedded so consumers can identify it without out-of-band context.

`$schema` names `docs/reference/schemas/update-record.json`, not the envelope artifact (`update.json`), because the two documents have different shapes: the envelope wraps a `repos` array; each streamed line is one flat per-repo object.

branch.description: Branch name from the manifest `version:` field.

error.description: Human-readable error message, only present when `kind = failed`.

files.description: How the files the advance rewrote were placed: cloned from another workspace of the repository, or written by the VCS. Absent when the advance moved nothing or the VCS cannot say.

new_sha.description: Tip SHA after the advance (`null` when `kind = failed`).

old_sha.description: Tip SHA before the advance (`null` if unreadable).

FilePlacement.description: How a member's tracked files reached a workspace.

hardlinked.description: Linked to another workspace's read-only copy.

reflinked.description: Cloned from another workspace's copy, sharing its storage until either is written.

written.description: Written by the version control system.

oneOf.description: Repo was advanced to a new SHA (old_sha != new_sha).
Repo was already at the branch HEAD (old_sha == new_sha).
Advance failed; see `error` for the message.
